the FE is a result of a complex competition of the bulk pinning, surface pinning and flux creep.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Fishtail is a manifestation of the competition between bulk pinning and surface barriers in the mixed state of high-temperature superconductors.
the evolution of FE with aging is related to the change of bulk and surface pinning.
FE is a complex phenomenon, which can be described by the competition between bulk pinning and surface barriers, and it is possible to control the FE by doping.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FE is a result of competition between bulk and surface pinning.
the FE can be used to determine the temperature range in which bulk and surface pinning mechanisms play the dominant role in flux pinning in the MG-YBCO crystals.
the FE is not a specific phenomenon of the YBCO crystals, but it can be observed in other high-temperature superconductors (HTS) and it is not related to the presence of the twin boundaries.
